title: Draft: feat(mcp): remove the experimental glab mcp command
description:
## Description

Removes the experimental `glab mcp` command. Users should use the [GitLab MCP Server](https://docs.gitlab.com/user/model_context_protocol/mcp_server/) instead. This is step 2 of the plan in the related issue: remove one milestone after the deprecation in !3998.

After this change, users who run `glab mcp serve` see:

```plaintext
❯ glab mcp serve

   ERROR

  Unknown command "mcp" for "glab"
```

This MR targets the !3998 branch so the diff shows only the removal. GitLab retargets it to `main` once !3998 merges.

- Deletes `internal/commands/mcp/` (the server and `glab mcp serve`) and its registration in `root.go`.
- Removes `cmdutils.AllowedValuer`, which only fed enum values into MCP tool schemas.
- Removes the `invocation_source` telemetry property (`internal/api/invocation_source.go`, `BuildInfo.InvocationSource`). Without the MCP server nothing sets it.
- Drops `github.com/modelcontextprotocol/go-sdk` and its indirect dependencies from `go.mod`.
- Drops `glab mcp serve` from two code comments and the MCP mention in `AGENTS.md`.

### Annotations are kept

The `mcpannotations` package, the annotation on every command, and the coverage test that requires one stay. The `Safe`/`Destructive` split is the read/write classification that read-only mode (#8353) plans to reuse. A follow-up can rename them to a neutral name, for example `cmdannotations.ReadOnly`, as part of that work. Comments in the two annotation tests no longer refer to the removed server.

## Related Issues

Closes #8583

## How has this been tested?

- `glab mcp serve` returns `Unknown command "mcp" for "glab"`.
- `make test-changed` passes: 4,575 tests, 8 skipped.
- `golangci-lint run --new-from-rev=origin/main ./...` reports 0 issues.
- `lefthook run pre-push` passes (build, lint, tests, generated docs and code, markdown).
